classification.difficultyReason: Continue the supplied calculation task through composite figures, including the provided construction ray and multiple parallel families.

content.prompt: Find the value of the pronumerals. You do not need to give reasoning.

spec.description: Triangle beneath a horizontal line parallel to its extended base. Exterior lower-left angle 104°, apex angle 52°, a below the upper line to the left of the triangle and b inside the lower-right vertex. Single rightward parallel arrows; no arcs or dots.
spec.mathematics: The lower-left interior angle is 76°. Parallel-line relationships and the straight angle at the apex give a=76 and b=52. Vertex names in code are not printed.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens and pronumerals appear; supplied answers belong to the answer field.

answer.worked:
The lower-left interior angle is $180^\circ-104^\circ=76^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}a&=76^\circ\end{align*}$$
Alternate angles on parallel lines.
$$\begin{align*}76^\circ+52^\circ+b&=180^\circ\\128^\circ+b&=180^\circ\\b&=52^\circ\end{align*}$$
Use alternate angles to transfer $b$ to the upper vertex, then angles on a straight line.

spec.description: Two horizontal parallel lines, rising diagonal and vertical connector. Exterior right-angle square at the bottom of the vertical; 35° below the upper line left of the diagonal, x below the upper line right of the vertical, y above the lower line left of the diagonal.
spec.mathematics: Parallel horizontals and the explicit perpendicular imply x=90. The angle supplementary to y equals 35 by alternate angles.

answer.worked:
$x=90^\circ$ by co-interior angles with the marked right angle. The lower acute angle is $35^\circ$ by alternate angles.
$$\begin{align*}y+35^\circ&=180^\circ\\y&=145^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Upper and lower rightward horizontal segments joined by a sloping connector. Matching single rightward arrows; a inside the upper bend and 68° inside the lower bend.

Two parallel lines rise rightwards. Triangle apex lies on upper line; base lies on lower line. At apex the sectors from right to left below the upper line are x, z, y. Lower-left exterior angle 124°; lower-right interior angle 57��.
spec.mathematics: x=57 by alternate angles; y+124=180 by co-interior angles; x+y+z=180 at the upper vertex.

answer.worked:
$x=57^\circ$ (alternate angles on parallel lines).

Co-interior angles:
$$\begin{align*}y+124^\circ&=180^\circ\\y&=56^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line:
$$\begin{align*}x+y+z&=180^\circ\\57^\circ+56^\circ+z&=180^\circ\\113^\circ+z&=180^\circ\\z&=67^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.mathematics: Two distinct marked parallel families. No right angle is asserted for the visually vertical connector.

spec.description: Three horizontal parallel lines; rising diagonal passes through middle intersection, and a second segment descends from that intersection to the bottom line. Top angle 41°. At middle intersection g upper-left, f upper-right, h lower-left and e lower-right outside the triangle. Bottom-right exterior angle 135°.
spec.mathematics: All horizontals share one parallel family. The rising diagonal is straight through the middle vertex.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens and unknowns; no numerical solution labels.

answer.worked:
$f=41^\circ$ (alternate angles on parallel lines).
$$\begin{align*}g+41^\circ&=180^\circ\\g&=139^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line. Also $h=f=41^\circ$ (vertically opposite angles).

Co-interior angles on the middle and bottom parallel lines:
$$\begin{align*}e+135^\circ&=180^\circ\\e&=45^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Adjacent right triangles on one baseline. Two verticals have double upward arrows; two descending diagonals have single up-left arrows. Both feet have right-angle squares. Left vertical extends upward; right diagonal extends upper-left. a inside left top vertex, 50° at middle foot between left diagonal and vertical, b and c at right top vertex on opposite sides of the downward vertical.
spec.mathematics: Retain both exact right-angle markers and both distinct parallel families.
spec.answerVisibility: Given 50°, a, b and c only.

answer.worked:
$a=50^\circ$ (alternate angles between the parallel verticals).

$c=a=50^\circ$ (corresponding angles).

Angles on a straight line:
$$\begin{align*}b+c&=180^\circ\\b+50^\circ&=180^\circ\\b&=130^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Two solid rising parallel lines joined by a bent connector. Dashed rightward rising parallel ray starts at its middle vertex. x° at upper junction, 110° in the left non-reflex sector at the bend and 60° at the lower junction. Single matching arrows on all three parallels; no curved arcs.
spec.mathematics: The supplied rightward construction ray lies outside the labelled 110° sector. Its two adjacent sectors are 180°−x and 180°−60°. Angles at a point therefore determine x.
spec.answerVisibility: The dashed ray is supplied question geometry, not a hidden solution overlay.

answer.worked:
The angle between the lower connector and the dashed ray is $180^\circ-60^\circ=120^\circ$ (co-interior angles).

Let the angle between the upper connector and the dashed ray be $\theta$.
$$\begin{align*}\theta+120^\circ+110^\circ&=360^\circ\\\theta+230^\circ&=360^\circ\\\theta&=130^\circ\end{align*}$$
Co-interior angles:
$$\begin{align*}x+130^\circ&=180^\circ\\x&=50^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Upper and lower horizontal lines with matching open rightward chevrons. Zigzag connector descends left, runs right, then descends left. Matching upward chevrons on the two sloping segments. Upper minor arc labelled 68° and lower obtuse arc labelled x°.
spec.mathematics: Two marked parallel families. The middle connector is unmarked. The source image appears to show a single open chevron on each slope; the inventory describes double marks, requiring reconciliation.

answer.worked:
The marked parallel sloping segments make equal acute angles with the marked parallel horizontal lines.

Angles on a straight line:
$$\begin{align*}x+68^\circ&=180^\circ\\x&=112^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Three parallel near-vertical lines lean down-right. Outer lines solid; middle dashed. Each has both endpoint arrowheads and an upward open chevron near its lower end. A V joins the outer lines through a lower vertex on the middle line. 27° and 53° are at outer junctions; a labels the entire V opening.
spec.mathematics: The dashed parallel divides the complete angle a into angles equal to 27° and 53° by alternate angles.
spec.answerVisibility: Dashed construction and full spanning arc are supplied question content. No component answers are added.

answer.worked:
The dashed parallel divides $a$ into $27^\circ$ and $53^\circ$ (alternate angles).
$$\begin{align*}a&=27^\circ+53^\circ\\a&=80^\circ\end{align*}$$
